method: Copy the rootless cumulative-before v3 archive, replace only its manifest producer_version with a source-sentinel string, then open and save it with a separately signed patched Stax server. Compare the saved manifest and imported PMU values. No root helper or hardware PMU collection was used.
inference: SavedRunArchiveProvenance describes the saving binary, not necessarily the binary that captured the run. A future PMU conversion marker placed only there could mislabel an older cumulative run after open/save. Capture-time per-run semantics must survive the archive round trip.
limitations: The sentinel version is synthetic and only tests provenance retention. It does not test a future PMU-semantics field or live M1 kperf counter behavior.
